question: When did Expo 2025 Osaka officially open?
solution:
The correct answer is option 1,Key Points

 
• Expo 2025 Osaka will officially open on **13 April 2025**, marking the beginning of a globally significant event.
 
• The Expo will be held on Yumeshima Island in Osaka, Japan, and will run until **October 13, 2025**.
 
• The theme for Expo 2025 Osaka is **"Designing Future Society for Our Lives."**
 
• The Expo aims to address global challenges such as sustainability, innovation, and societal well-being through international collaboration.
